prompt: Six separate small illustrations arranged in a neat grid of two rows and three columns, all the same size. Top row from left to right: a small white rubber eraser with a navy paper sleeve around its middle, lying flat, seen at an angle; a wide classroom chalkboard seen straight from the front, dark slate surface, light wooden frame, a small ledge with one piece of white chalk; a clear drinking glass filled with pale blue water and two ice cubes. Bottom row from left to right: a small two-colored eraser with rounded corners, one half ochre and one half navy; a dark chalkboard on a wooden stand with two legs, seen straight from the front, with a blank surface; a clear glass of light blue water next to a clear glass water bottle. Every item is complete, separated from the others by wide empty white space, and does not touch the edges of the image. Modern minimalist editorial illustration, calm and refined, simplified geometric forms, flat matte colors with a very fine subtle grain, restrained palette of deep navy, slate gray, warm sand and ivory with one muted ochre accent, natural muted skin tones, minimal facial features, soft subtle shadows. Plain white background, wordless.
